title: The Effects of Stock Ownership on Individual Spending, Investments, and Loyalty
eligible_reason: Staggered account-opening design: Bumped users are taken off a waitlist and open brokerage accounts in different weeks (week_open), and the main regressions use user fixed effects and week fixed effects with binary relative-time indicators built from week_open (post8week = weeks 0-8 after opening, longterm_9plus = more than 8 weeks after; or l8open_ind-l1open_ind, week_open_ind, f1open_ind-f8open_ind, longterm_9plus). No controls, no weights in the main columns (CPS reweighting only in appendix Table A6). Table 4 columns 1-3, Table 7 columns 1-4, the Figure 4 event studies, the Figure 5 grant event studies and the Figure 7 left-panel 24-week event study qualify. Columns and figures interacting the indicators with grantrec_dummy (Table 4 column 4, Figures 6 and 7 right panels) do not. All users eventually open accounts, so identification relies on not-yet-treated users (no never-treated group for the opening event); for the grant event (Figure 5) the sample is restricted to grant recipients. Data are proprietary with on-site access only.
design_notes: User-week panel of Bumped, Inc. customers (about 11,400 users) built from card transactions, May 2018 to March 2020 (collapsed at line 801 of 2. main_analysis.do, saved as aftercollapse_week_reg_anal.dta). week_open = yw(year_open, wiy_open) from date_acct_opened; week_wait from date_waitlist; week_grant from grant dates. Outcomes are winsorized ratios of spending relative to the user's own mean (ratio_spending_el eligible spending, ratio_spending_inel ineligible spending, ratio_amount total), amounts, logs, brokerage transfers (ratio_amt_broker, amt_broker, log_amt_broker, trnsfr_ind) and ATM withdrawals. Event-study reference: l1open_ind is included and coefficients are plotted relative to it, so the omitted category is weeks more than 8 before opening. Clustering two-way by user_id and week. did2s (Gardner) version of Figure 4 in Figure A18 and a stacked (stackedev) version in Figure A19; waitlist-timing event study (l8wait_ind ...) in the appendix.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Weekly account-opening cohorts over roughly 2018-2019; count unknown without data (likely dozens).

specs.treatment_definition: post8week = 1 in the opening week and the 8 following weeks (week_open_ind or f1-f8open_ind); longterm_9plus = 1 if week - week_open > 8; pre-opening weeks are the reference
specs.sample_condition: all users with non-missing eligible spending ratio

specs.treatment_definition: as above, interacted with grant recipient indicator

specs.treatment_var: l8open_ind ... l1open_ind week_open_ind f1open_ind ... f8open_ind longterm_9plus
specs.treatment_definition: weekly relative-time indicators around week_open; longterm_9plus bins weeks > 8; reference = weeks more than 8 before opening (plotted relative to l1open_ind)
specs.notes: Loop over 14 outcomes; ratio_spending_el and ratio_spending_inel are Figure 4, the category-level outcomes are Figure A7.

specs.treatment_var: l8grant_ind ... l1grant_ind week_grant_ind f1grant_ind ... f8grant_ind longtermgrant_9plus
specs.treatment_definition: weekly relative-time indicators around week_grant (receipt of a stock grant, Red Robin promotion or spot grant); longtermgrant_9plus = week - week_grant > 8
specs.cluster: two-way user_id and week, assembled from three runs (cluster(id), cluster(user_id), cluster(week))
specs.notes: Grant timing is described in the abstract as quasi-random.

specs.treatment_var: l8open_ind ... l1open_ind week_open_ind f1open_ind ... f24open_ind longterm_24plus
specs.treatment_definition: weekly relative-time indicators to week 24 after opening; longterm_24plus bins weeks > 24
specs.sample_condition: switch == 0 (users who did not switch brands)

specs.exclusion_reason: relative-time indicators interacted with grantrec_dummy (subgroup-by-treatment interactions)
specs.outcome: ratio_spending_el (Fig 6 left), ratio_spending_el_RR (Fig 6 right, line 1779; Fig 7 right, line 1891)
specs.treatment_var: l8open_ind_gr ... f8open_ind_gr plus l8open_ind ... f8open_ind longterm_9plus longterm_9plus_gr
specs.treatment_definition: opening event-time indicators and their interactions with grant receipt

specs.treatment_var: did2s second stage: l8open_ind ... f8open_ind longterm_9plus; treatment(treat) with treat = week >= week_open
specs.cluster: two-way assembled from cluster(id), cluster(user_id), cluster(week)
specs.notes: Appendix only; listed because it is the paper's heterogeneity-robust estimate of the Figure 4 design. Not counted in n_eligible_specs.

data_files_note: All Bumped administrative extracts, survey files, Robinhood holdings, SafeGraph spending and ticker prices are proprietary; folders contain PLACEHOLDER.txt only. README: an Alternative Disclosure Plan agreed with the Department Editor offers on-site replication access at the University of Houston (contact [email removed]). Full pipeline takes about 24 hours.
software_notes: Stata 17 MP (reghdfe 6.12.5, ftools, estout, did2s, modified stackedev ado shipped as Code/stackedev_stderror_v2.ado).
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). Table and figure locations come from comments in 2. main_analysis.do and the README output map (Table 4 line 1146, Table 7 line 3210, Figure 4 line 1427 in README vs. loop at line 1366 in code). Published coefficients are not recoverable from the package (log file is of a run on real data but was not inspected for coefficients; stock_ownership_loyalty.log is present and could be parsed). All users eventually open accounts, so TWFE comparisons rely on not-yet-treated users; the last-opening cohorts have no untreated comparison in late weeks, which is relevant for the negative-weight analysis if data access is ever obtained.
